description: The Labels Basemap is a transparent map layer that emphasizes place name labels — such as cities, suburbs, and landmarks — while also showing roads for reference. It’s typically used as an overlay on imagery to provide geographic context without obscuring the underlying aerial view.  Best placed as a layer over the top of the State Aerial Photo basemap, or the Hillshade basemaps.
